# Fit the cage surface in world metres. Apply each neutral displacement to
# its paint guards and every expression, preserving the expression deltas.
set_expression({})
basis=face.data.shape_keys.key_blocks['Basis']
P=np.array([list(face.matrix_world@v.co) for v in basis.data])
W=P.copy()
W[:,1]*=-1 # forward
skin=set(i for f in raw.skin_faces for i in f)
mid=np.array(sorted(i for i in skin if abs(W[i,0])<.0005 and W[i,1]>.025))
# The shared material boundary is the real lower edge of the face cage.
seam=np.array(sorted(skin & {i for f in raw.under_faces for i in f}))
cs=seam[np.argmax(W[seam,1])]
chin=W[cs].copy()
ears=np.array(sorted({i for f in raw.mesh.f[slice(*raw._ear_faces)] for i in f}))
ear=W[ears[np.argmin(W[ears,2])]].copy()
high=max((hair_ob.matrix_world@v.co).z for v in hair_ob.data.vertices)
H=high-chin[2]
def centre_at(frac):
    return mid[np.argmin(abs(W[mid,2]-(chin[2]+frac*H)))]
features={n:centre_at(z) for n,z in [('root',.394),('brow',.485),('nose',.268),('lip',.156)]}
root=features['root']
goal={'root':0.,'brow':.020,'nose':.108,'lip':.059}
def knots():
    points=[(chin[2]-.012,0.),(chin[2]+.017,0.),(chin[2]+H*.72,0.)]
    for n,i in features.items():
        points.append((W[i,2],W[root,1]+H*goal[n]-W[i,1]))
    return np.array(sorted(points)).T
zz,dd=knots()
ear_lift=chin[2]+math.tan(math.radians(31.2))*(chin[1]-ear[1])-ear[2]
# Project the lateral jaw seam into an ascending curve. The neck follows
# behind it, set farther back and narrowed beneath the mandibular angle.
curve=W[seam];ii=np.argsort(curve[:,1])
def delta(x,f,z):
    depth=max(0.,chin[1]-f)
    seam_z=np.interp(f,curve[ii,1],curve[ii,2])
    rise=math.tan(math.radians(31.2))*depth
    desired=chin[2]+rise
    zone=math.exp(-((z-seam_z)/.032)**2)*sat((f-ear[1]+.016)/.024)
    jaw=(desired-seam_z)*zone
    ear_zone=math.exp(-((f-ear[1])/.027)**2-((z-ear[2])/.039)**2)*sat((abs(x)-.035)/.025)
    jaw=jaw*(1-ear_zone)+ear_lift*ear_zone
    throat=sat((chin[2]+.004-z)/.020)*sat((z-chin[2]+.086)/.045)*sat((f+.01)/.055)
    project=np.interp(z,zz,dd)*math.exp(-(x/.029)**2)*sat((f-.035)/.022)
    return Vector((-x*.14*throat,.019*throat-project,jaw))
D=[face.matrix_world.to_3x3().inverted()@delta(*w) for w in W]
for key in face.data.shape_keys.key_blocks:
    for i,v in enumerate(key.data): v.co+=D[i]
for i,v in enumerate(face.data.vertices): v.co=basis.data[i].co
for v in neck.data.vertices:
    p=neck.matrix_world@v.co
    v.co+=neck.matrix_world.to_3x3().inverted()@delta(p.x,-p.y,p.z)
# Pull the hanging underside of the cap up behind the pinna. Keep its
# attachment ring shared in place, and taper the three interior rows.
def hair_tuck():
    mesh=hair_ob.data
    start=len(mesh.vertices)-2*23*7-5*72
    for level in range(1,5):
        for j in range(72):
            v=mesh.vertices[start+level*72+j]
            rear=(1-math.cos(j*math.tau/72))*.5
            a=sat((rear-.44)/.18)*sat((1.04-rear)/.25)
            rootv=mesh.vertices[start+j].co
            v.co.z+=(rootv.z-v.co.z)*.86*a
            v.co.x*=1-.19*a*level/4
            v.co.y+=.009*a*level/4
hair_tuck()
face.data.update();neck.data.update();hair_ob.data.update()
bpy.context.view_layer.update()
def point_at(i):
    p=face.matrix_world@basis.data[i].co
    return np.array((p.x,-p.y,p.z))
c=point_at(cs);e=point_at(ears[np.argmin(W[ears,2])])
H=high-c[2]
measures=dict(jaw_deg=math.degrees(math.atan2(e[2]-c[2],c[1]-e[1])),H_m=H,
    profile={n:float((point_at(i)[1]-point_at(root)[1])/H) for n,i in features.items()},
    landmark_vertices={n:int(i) for n,i in features.items()},chin=c.tolist(),ear=e.tolist())
(ROOT/'stage2-measures.json').write_text(json.dumps(measures,indent=2))

# Locate the bottom of the projecting chin pad, anterior to the throat.
pts=np.array([point_at(i) for i in range(len(basis.data))])
candidates=[i for i in mid if pts[i,1]>.082 and pts[i,2]<1.442]
chin_id=min(candidates,key=lambda i:pts[i,2])
c=pts[chin_id];ear_id=ears[np.argmin(pts[ears,2])];e=pts[ear_id]
H=high-c[2];slope=math.tan(math.radians(31.2))
lift=c[2]+(c[1]-e[1])*slope-e[2]
def second_fit(x,f,z):
    back=c[1]-f
    # Fold the inferior surface up to the mandibular edge while the
    # cervical column descends behind it. Leave the eye socket untouched.
    edge=c[2]+slope*max(0.,min(.09,back))
    height_gate=sat((z-c[2]+.040)/.035)
    lower=max(0.,edge-z)*sat((f+.018)/.024)*height_gate
    lateral=sat((abs(x)-.013)/.031)
    # The forward floor rises across its full width. Behind the middle
    # of the mandible the throat continues down inside the narrower edge.
    support=max(lateral,sat((f-.032)/.029))
    dz=lower*support
    ear_region=sat((abs(x)-.042)/.021)*math.exp(-((f-e[1])/.025)**4)
    dz=dz*(1-ear_region)+lift*ear_region*math.exp(-((z-e[2])/.043)**4)
    # Draw in the lower temporal scalp under the tucked hair, beyond the ear.
    rear=sat((.001-f)/.037)*sat((1.53-z)/.035)*sat((z-1.426)/.025)
    narrow=-x*.32*rear
    # Nasion, philtrum and mentolabial fold between the three projections.
    hollow=.0032*math.exp(-((z-1.451)/.0032)**2)+.0022*math.exp(-((z-1.474)/.004)**2)
    hollow*=math.exp(-(x/.020)**2)*sat((f-.060)/.020)
    return Vector((narrow,hollow,dz))
offsets=[face.matrix_world.to_3x3().inverted()@second_fit(*w) for w in pts]
for key in face.data.shape_keys.key_blocks:
    for i,v in enumerate(key.data):v.co+=offsets[i]
for i,v in enumerate(face.data.vertices):v.co=basis.data[i].co
for v in neck.data.vertices:
    p=neck.matrix_world@v.co
    v.co+=neck.matrix_world.to_3x3().inverted()@second_fit(p.x,-p.y,p.z)
# Along the sloping edge, let the cage's own smooth normal turn towards
# its underside. Preserve the previous eye and upper cheek normal fields.
for poly in face.data.polygons:
    if face.data.materials[poly.material_index].name not in (generator.MAT['face'],generator.MAT['skin']):continue
    for li in poly.loop_indices:
        i=face.data.loops[li].vertex_index
        x,f,z=point_at(i)
        edge=c[2]+slope*(c[1]-f)
        shadow=sat((edge+.0025-z)/.005)*sat((.080-f)/.018)*sat((f+.012)/.025)*sat((z-1.407)/.017)
        data=face.data.color_attributes['Color'].data[li]
        rgb=list(data.color)
        for j,k in enumerate((.78,.64,.57)):rgb[j]*=1-shadow*(1-k)
        data.color=rgb
# Shape the cap's visible hem behind the ear as a receding tapered edge.
# Keep the front loose strands and the plait clear of this zone.
for v in hair_ob.data.vertices:
    p=hair_ob.matrix_world@v.co
    x,f,z=p.x,-p.y,p.z
    if f<.002 and abs(x)>.026 and 1.40<z<1.515:
        w=sat((.006-f)/.035)*sat((1.515-z)/.050)*sat((z-1.40)/.035)
        v.co+=hair_ob.matrix_world.to_3x3().inverted()@Vector((-x*w*.21,.012*w,.016*w))
face.data.update();neck.data.update();hair_ob.data.update();bpy.context.view_layer.update()
c2,e2=point_at(chin_id),point_at(ear_id)
measures=dict(chin=c2.tolist(),ear=e2.tolist(),H_m=high-c2[2],
